rulesTestNames: lets current managers get contact, application and attendance report views by id
owner: Host read model projector: hostReadModels application detail view triggers
read: current organizer managers get by id while their account is not deleted; a view not written yet reads as missing
write: server only; written from the application, its generic-form or imported response, its contact origin and the applicant's community membership, deleted with the application
migrationNotes: detail equals what getOrganizerApplicationDetail returns; the callable and the view share one projection. The host-application-detail-views copy-forward migration creates views for applications recorded before the triggers.
Review and membership decisions stay callables that reread every source in their transactions and check the revisions the phone saw.
